r42.summary: Addresses that bounce or complain are never emailed again, the faster live channel switches on, owners hear about a booking the moment it starts counting toward their revenue, and a rental covered by a credit card must be paid with that card's network.

staff: A deposit hold on a card now lasts about 30 days on Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover cards (about 7 days on other cards), so fewer holds need to be placed again during a rental
If a card cannot take the longer hold, the usual hold is placed by itself, so nobody is stopped
Sales gets a To-do for every request to book that was refused or failed, once per person, car and day; it closes by itself when the request arrives
When a booking that was left out of the owner's revenue starts counting, the owner gets the new booking email once, at that moment
admins: Requests that did not go through on All leads shows how many, the reasons, and each person with the car and dates
Connect the search console with one button and the site reads its own search figures every day: clicks, impressions and average position for the last 28 days
A page that ranks just under the first results, or is shown often and rarely clicked, is written again by itself, a few pages a day; the sitemap is submitted every day
An address whose mailbox does not exist, or that reports one of our emails as unwanted, is blocked automatically and not emailed again
A card of another network than the one that covers a rental is refused on the server before the booking is confirmed, with nothing charged
More people can send requests from one shared internet connection in an hour (30, was 5)
owners: You hear about a booking the moment it starts counting toward your revenue: the new booking email arrives once, at that moment, never twice

The owner guide now says which bookings an owner statement carries: bookings paid by the renter always, and not a booking billed to an insurer that is hidden from you or that does not block the calendar
renters: When your rental is covered by your credit card, the pay page says "Pay with the card that covers this rental" with the card's network, and stops a card of another network before it is charged
A request to book that cannot be sent now says exactly what to change, beside the field, and keeps everything you typed
An add-on that cannot be added online no longer stops your request: staff confirm it in the offer
investors: Fewer lost requests: a request to book that is refused or fails is kept, and Sales follows up with the person
Emails to addresses that bounce or complain stop automatically, which protects our sending reputation
The site reads its own search figures every day and rewrites pages that rank just under the first results

r43.summary: Staff taking calls get a Call helper, only Sales is hired by the AI interview by itself, with video answers scored out of 10 and a stricter pass, every car shows its front exterior first, and the Protection Plan switch uses the car's own price.

staff: Check-in and check-out are one screen instead of ten to fourteen steps, with the odometer, fuel and keys filled in for you and a tick on each part when it is done
A late return is never charged by itself: on the return screen or the booking you choose an extension, extra days, the late return fee, a custom amount or a waiver, each with a reason where needed
The caller pop-up has a Call helper with a greeting, a button for each kind of call and quick answers; it minimizes to a small bar when you click outside it
Every list of people and records can be sorted newest first, and opens newest first
Hiring and onboarding are one pipeline with the next action on each line
After each release a What's new pop-up shows what changed
admins: Only Sales applicants are hired by the AI interview by themselves; every other role that passes books an interview date
The AI interview takes video answers only, with two minutes per question, scores each answer out of 10 and is stricter; Redo the AI interview sends a new link
Approvals waiting for you are first on Staff and roles and on Today
Redo photos with Gemini remakes a car's outside photos, and every car's first photo is its front exterior
Switching a booking to the Protection Plan uses the car's plan price
Add a rental: the renter's email is optional for past rentals, insurer-billed rentals, or when marked not to email
owners: Your dashboard and car pages show each car's current kilometres and its next service, in km or by date
renters: Every car's first photo is its exterior from the front
Returning the car yourself always sends your report: if a photo or reading is missing, staff confirm the return instead of the form refusing
investors: Hiring is stricter: video-only AI interviews scored per answer, and only Sales is hired without a person
Check-in and check-out are faster and late returns are charged by a staff decision, never automatically
